title: Compliance with Safeguarding Covered Defense Information Controls
applicability: Included in DoD solicitations for contracts that will involve CUI. Offerors must complete this representation as part of their proposal.

title: Limitations on the Use or Disclosure of Third-Party Contractor Reported Cyber Incident Information
applicability: Applies to all DoD contracts where the government receives cyber incident information from contractors under the 7012 reporting requirements.

title: Safeguarding Covered Defense Information and Cyber Incident Reporting
applicability: All DoD contracts where the contractor will process, store, or transmit Covered Defense Information (CDI) or operationally critical support information.

title: Notice of NIST SP 800-171 DoD Assessment Requirements
applicability: Solicitations and contracts that include DFARS 252.204-7012 and require a current NIST 800-171 assessment score in SPRS.

title: NIST SP 800-171 DoD Assessment Requirements
applicability: Contracts where the government requires a Medium or High confidence NIST 800-171 assessment, typically for contracts involving high-value CUI.

title: Cybersecurity Maturity Model Certification Requirements
applicability: DoD contracts that specify a required CMMC level. Currently being phased in, with full implementation expected by 2028.

title: Cloud Computing Services
applicability: Contracts that involve the use of cloud computing services to process, store, or transmit DoD data, including CUI and other sensitive information.

title: Rights in Technical Data—Noncommercial Items
applicability: All DoD contracts for noncommercial items that involve the creation or delivery of technical data.

title: Rights in Other Than Commercial Computer Software and Other Than Commercial Computer Software Documentation
applicability: DoD contracts for noncommercial software development or delivery of noncommercial computer software documentation.

title: Technical Data—Commercial Items
applicability: DoD contracts for commercial items where technical data is delivered or required.

title: Identification and Assertion of Use, Release, or Disclosure Restrictions
applicability: Included in DoD solicitations to collect contractor assertions about data rights restrictions before contract award.

title: Rights in Other Than Commercial Technical Data and Computer Software—Small Business Innovation Research Program
applicability: SBIR and STTR contracts awarded by the DoD.

title: Validation of Asserted Restrictions—Computer Software
applicability: DoD contracts where the government questions the validity of contractor-asserted restrictions on computer software.

title: Supply Chain Risk
applicability: DoD IT acquisitions where supply chain risk assessments indicate potential threats from specific suppliers or sources.

title: Buy American and Balance of Payments Program
applicability: DoD supply contracts for end products, including manufactured items, raw materials, and assemblies.

title: Qualifying Country Sources as Subcontractors
applicability: DoD contracts where Buy American requirements apply and foreign subcontractors from qualifying countries may be used.

title: Prohibition on the Acquisition of Covered Defense Telecommunications Equipment or Services
applicability: All DoD contracts. This is a broad prohibition applying to procurement, use, and provision of covered telecommunications equipment.

title: Item Unique Identification and Valuation
applicability: DoD contracts for delivery of items valued over $5,000 or mission-essential items, excluding commercial items with existing unique identification.

title: Small Business Subcontracting Plan (DoD Contracts)
applicability: DoD contracts over $750,000 awarded to large businesses where subcontracting opportunities exist.

title: Small Business Subcontracting Plan (Test Program)
applicability: Contractors approved to participate in the DoD comprehensive subcontracting plan test program.

title: Notification to Delay Performance
applicability: DoD small business set-aside contracts.

title: Cost Estimating System Requirements
applicability: Negotiated DoD contracts over $50 million where cost or pricing data is required.

title: Electronic Submission of Payment Requests and Receiving Reports
applicability: All DoD contracts except those paid by purchase card or below the micro-purchase threshold.

title: Wide Area WorkFlow Payment Instructions
applicability: All DoD contracts using WAWF/iRAPT for payment processing.

title: Prohibition on Interrogation of Detainees by Contractor Personnel
applicability: DoD contracts for services that may involve interaction with detainees.

title: Contractor Business Systems
applicability: CAS-covered contracts (typically cost-reimbursement, incentive, and T&M contracts over $50 million) where DCMA oversight is required.

title: Contractor Counterfeit Electronic Part Detection and Avoidance System
applicability: DoD contracts for electronic parts or assemblies containing electronic parts.

title: Sources of Electronic Parts
applicability: DoD contracts delivering electronic parts or assemblies containing electronic parts.

title: Transportation of Supplies by Sea
applicability: DoD contracts where supplies will be transported by ocean vessel.

title: Disclosure of Information
applicability: DoD contracts involving sensitive information where uncontrolled disclosure could be detrimental.
